'''Rockchewer''' was a [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It was killed by the team [[Mission to the Lost Island|assaulting]] the [[Lost Island|laboratory]] of Doctor [[Sannus Lorrick]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Lost Island}}</ref>
